# st-cloudflare_domain (Resource)

Register a domain through the Cloudflare Registrar. Registration goes through the Registrar Registrations API via the official cloudflare-go SDK; when the resource's `use_sandbox` attribute is set, it targets the Registrar Sandbox endpoints instead, which allow free test registrations (`.com`/`.net` only) without real domains or billing.

Requires the provider `api_token`; the `account_id` is set on the resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "st-cloudflare_domain" "example_domain" {
  account_id     = "023e105f4ecef8ad9ca31a8372d0c353"
  domain         = "example.com"
  purchase_years = 1
  auto_renew     = true
  privacy        = true
}
```

The registrant contact is optional: when the `registrant_contact` block is omitted, the account's default address book contact is used (set once under Domain Registration → Registrant Contact in the Cloudflare dashboard). In sandbox mode, a built-in placeholder contact is filled in automatically — see the schema below for the nested fields when you want to provide your own.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account_id` (String) The Cloudflare account ID that owns the registration. Changing this registers the domain under a different account (forces replacement).
- `auto_renew` (Boolean) Whether the domain is automatically renewed before expiration. Setting `true` authorizes Cloudflare to charge the account's default payment method up to 30 days before expiry.
- `domain` (String) Domain name to register (FQDN, e.g. `example.com`).
- `privacy` (Boolean) WHOIS privacy: `true` requests redaction, `false` disables it. Cannot be changed after registration.

### Optional

- `purchase_years` (Number) Registration term in years (1-10). Defaults to the registry's minimum period (1 year for most extensions). Cannot be changed after registration.
- `registrant_contact` (Attributes) Registrant contact for the registration. When omitted, the account's default address book entry is used; without either, registration fails. In sandbox mode a built-in placeholder contact is used when omitted. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--registrant_contact))
- `use_sandbox` (Boolean) Register through the Registrar Sandbox endpoints instead of the production Registrar: free test registrations (`.com`/`.net` only), no billing, no real domains. Defaults to `false`. Changing it forces replacement.

### Read-Only

- `domain_expiry_date` (String) The expiry date of the domain in ISO 8601 format (e.g. `2027-01-15T10:00:00Z`). Computed automatically from the registration.
- `status` (String) Registration status, e.g. `active`, `expired`, `suspended`.

<a id="nestedatt--registrant_contact"></a>
### Nested Schema for `registrant_contact`

Required:

- `city` (String) City or locality name.
- `country_code` (String) Two-letter country code per ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (e.g. `US`).
- `email` (String) Email address of the registrant.
- `name` (String) Full legal name of the contact in one string, e.g. `Ada Lovelace`.
- `phone` (String) Phone number in E.164 format, e.g. `+1.5555555555`.
- `postal_code` (String) Postal or ZIP code.
- `street` (String) Street address including building/suite number.

Optional:

- `fax` (String) Fax number in E.164 format. Optional.
- `organization` (String) Organization or company name. Optional for individual registrants.
- `state` (String) State, province, or region (standard abbreviation, e.g. `TX`).

## Notes

- **Updates**: the Cloudflare Registrar API supports updating `auto_renew` only. Changing `purchase_years`, `privacy`, or `registrant_contact` after creation produces an explicit error.
- **Delete**: domain registrations cannot be deleted in Cloudflare; `terraform destroy` only removes the resource from state and logs a warning. The domain stays registered — disable `auto_renew` to stop renewal charges.
- **Sandbox**: `use_sandbox = true` registers against `/registrar-sandbox/` — no billing, no real domains, `.com`/`.net` only, and sandbox purchases are persisted (a name bought there is not re-buyable in the sandbox). The `st-cloudflare_zone_type` resource is unaffected: zone operations always run against the production Cloudflare API.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# Production registration:
terraform import st-cloudflare_domain.example_domain <account_id>/<domain>

# Registrar Sandbox registration:
terraform import st-cloudflare_domain.example_domain sandbox/<account_id>/<domain>
```

The account ID is needed to locate the registration; sandbox registrations require the `sandbox/` prefix because they live under the Registrar Sandbox endpoints.
